people.name: Amr El-Sheraey
people.headline: Full-stack engineer in Cairo
people.bio: Computer Science and AI graduate of FCAI, Cairo University, building document-intelligence software at Syntheia. A normal week touches a TypeScript API, a React front end, a Python ML service and a Helm chart. Most useful where those meet, and most interested in whichever part I have not done before.
